fact: PAFEN issued on 23 September 2026 a World Bank-financed request for proposals to design, build and deploy an end-to-end electronic public procurement (e-GP) system for Burundi, proposals due 13 November 2026.
The finance minister said the e-GP e-procurement platform, set up by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy, is due to enter into force from 2027.
The public procurement regulator's director general says at least seven of fourteen planned activities for the e-GP system are done and first tests are expected early 2027.
